item.title: Dave Hodge unrepentant about pen flip that ended his run on Hockey Night in Canada
item.description: It was the Jose Bautista of pen flips, one that cost Dave Hodge the most prestigious sports broadcasting job in the country. Almost 40 years later, the 81-year-old Hodge doesn’t regret it one bit. Judging from the applause when he re-told the tale at Monday’s NHL Alumni Lunch, he’s still respected for his split-second call out of his network for leaving an overtime game for the 11 p.m. news. “What I (essentially) said was ‘finish what you started,” former host Hodge told his […]
